info.title: volter-tunnel relay
info.description: The volter-tunnel relay's HTTP surface at its apex: its status. A client's control channel (a WebSocket at /ws?id=<tunnelId>) and the public requests it answers (every path of <tunnelId>.<domain>) are the relay's protocol, recorded in spec/SOURCE.md. Written from volter-ai/volter-tunnel (spec/SOURCE.md).
